items.title: Best Buy Store Rollout Could Change The Case For Zip Co (ASX:ZIP)

The rollout into Best Buy locations comes as Zip reports in-store purchases at 30% of U.S. transaction volume and 61% year over year growth in U.S. in-store transaction volume in First Quarter Fiscal Year 27, highlighting the growing role of physical retail in its payments mix.
